title: Just Ask Jev: Reinforcement Learning for Calibrated Decisions as a Zero-Shot Detector of AI Alignment Failures

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing model outputs for demographic variants via counterfactual name swapping in reference letters and professional bios, and evaluating forced-gap prompts in workplace scenes (WinoBias) to detect stereotype-consistent differences.
